sentencePerformance.voiceDirection: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “unwanted app / short videos”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

scenes.alt: A parent stands by a family table with a tablet (an unwanted app with a removal cross) and a phone streaming short videos. With raised brows and an open hand she senses a connection: a dashed bridge with a question mark arcs between the devices. She offers an open hand to the child, who pushes the app away and then turns and steps toward the videos, reaching for the phone.
